items.label: Soft, Breathable & Lightweight Fabric
items.value: Made from a blend of 60% Polyester, 35% Rayon, and 5% Spandex. Whether you're enjoying a summer day or lounging at home, this set's soft, breathable fabric keeps you cool and comfortable—just like your favorite summer dress or sundress, but with the easy flexibility of a two-piece

items.label: Relaxed & Adjustable Fit
items.value: Designed with a loose-fitting top and shorts with an elastic waistband and drawstring. This two-piece set provides a customizable, comfortable fit that flatters your silhouette—whether you're between sizes or just want that "just right" feel without any fuss

items.label: Hands-Free Convenience with Pockets
items.value: The shorts feature two side pockets, offering a secure place for your essentials like a phone, keys, or cards. No more digging around—everything stays within reach whether you're lounging at home or out on casual errands

items.label: Versatile for Multiple Occasions
items.value: Easily transitions from loungewear to athleisure, travel, beach vacation, airport outfits or sleepwear. Pair it with sneakers for a casual look or mix and match each piece with your wardrobe for more ways to wear

items: Easy Care & Size Guidance：For easy maintenance, machine wash cold and tumble dry on low. Avoid bleach. For the right fit, please use the Size Chart in the product images before ordering—so you're happy with how it fits from day one
